objective: Standard statement: with a SAT encoding of rotation systems and face labels, compute the exact orientable genus of the incidence graphs of all three-fold spaces up to 22 points and of larger ones (Fano compositions, cycles of Fano blocks, the twisted cube, the 35-point space with trisum glue), confirming ticket A's formula; enumerate the minimum-genus rotation systems of the small spaces and compare their number and orbits with the connected-sum structure; test the splice lemma on assorted graphs and its failure for K3,3 with K3,3. Nearest known result: ticket A; THREEFOLD-GRAMMAR-20261030-001B. Classification: to be decided.
status: Proved: exact SAT genus equals the sum of the braces' genera on all 32 classes up to 22 points (the Heawood count for every untwisted class) and on 9 larger spaces up to 180 vertices (trisum glue adds one); the 7-, 13- and 19-point spaces have exactly 16, 128 and 1024 minimum-genus rotation systems, all standard connected sums (orbits 1, 2 and 3-6); additivity holds with one rigid side and fails for K3,3 with K3,3.
title: Exact genera and minimal maps by SAT
